bundle.text:
# dsh-fish-theme bundle patch — one inserted loader row.
# The loader imports this package's host half (index.js), which registers the
# /dsh-fish-theme/*.webp image routes; the node half sees this package's
# `dsh.client` declaration and serves client.js to the browser.
- insert:
    - id: fish-theme
      name: 'dsh-fish-theme'

readme.text: <div align="center">
**鲸鱼娘配色 · 双层水印 · 终端风深色主题** [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Web 界面主题插件 **中文** · [English](README.en.md) ---

| 主界面 | 设置面板 |
|---|---|
|  |  |

左图：**左侧**是固定水印（女仆站姿立绘），**正文区左下**是可切换水印（这里选的是「吃饱饱」），**右下角**那只小家伙是桌宠 —— 见下方「搭配使用」。

右图：设置 → 通用设置里的四行选项，以及 21 张底图的缩略图列表。

> ⚠️ 这两张都是**浅色模式**（墨青配色）。**终端配色只在深色模式下才显示它那套纯黑代码面板 + 金琥珀关键字。**
>
> 🌙 **深色模式建议把「可切换底图浓淡」设为「浓」。** 固定层用的 `multiply` 是给白底设计的退底方式 —— 深色背景上「深色 × 图」仍然接近深色，水印会淡到几乎看不见；可切换层里也有一部分图走同样机制，所以整体给「浓」更稳。

一个给 DSH Web 界面换肤的插件包。它做三件事：

1. **重配整套颜色 token** —— 5 套配色，浅色深色同时定义
2. **叠两层背景水印** —— 一层固定不动，一层可切换
3. **重着色代码语法** —— 9 类 token，按 Windows Terminal 的配色

配色和设置**会被记住**，进出设置页不会重置。

| 名称 | 风格 |
|---|---|
| 青蓝 | 冷蓝主线，默认 |
| 素白 | 无色偏，最中性 |
| 靛紫 | 紫调 |
| 墨青 | 青绿调 |
| **终端** | **仿 Windows Terminal，深色下是纯黑代码面板 + 金琥珀关键字** |

readme.section: 背景水印（两层，互相独立）
readme.text:
两层各用一个伪元素（`body::after` / `body::before`），因为**同一个元素的 `opacity` 会同时作用于它的所有背景层** —— 想各有各的浓度就必须分开。

| 层 | 内容 | 可调 |
|---|---|---|
| **固定层** | 女仆站姿立绘，左侧 | ❌ 锁定「淡」，不暴露给用户 |
| **可切换层** | 21 张表情包任选 | ✅ 形象 + 浓淡（关/淡/中/浓）|

> 🌙 **深色模式下建议把浓淡设为「浓」**（原因见上面「预览」一节）。固定层锁死在「淡」，它在深色背景上同样很淡 —— 这是已知取舍：固定层不暴露给用户，是为了保证它永远不被误调。

**为什么用不同混合模式**：白底立绘靠 `mix-blend-mode: multiply` 把白底抹掉、只留线条；透明贴纸则**不能**用 multiply（会把浅色压成脏色），改用纯合成。每张图的 `kind` 是按**透明占比实测**决定的，不是猜的。

readme.section: 背景水印（两层，互相独立）
readme.text: **位置是运行时量的**：可切换层的左边距从页面的内联 `grid-template-columns` 里读取侧栏真实宽度（侧栏可拖动，264–420px），所以拖动侧栏后松手会重排 —— 而不是写死一个 280px。
`褐色`（默认，取当前配色的 `warn` 色，在终端配色下与关键字同源）· `中性` · `冷青` · `跟随强调色` · `无底色`

readme.section: 终端配色做了两件具体的事
readme.text:
**① 语法重着色。** Shiki 的颜色**不是主题 token**，而是 `ui-theme/src/styles/shiki.css` 里声明的普通 CSS 变量（`--shiki-token-*`）。主题的 29 个 token 里**一个代码着色项都没有** —— 所以只能覆盖这些 CSS 变量，用与原样式表**完全相同的选择器**（`:root` / `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`），靠注入顺序取胜，不用 `!important`。

9 类 token 取自 Windows Terminal 的 **Campbell** 配色（Win11 上 PowerShell 7 的默认色）：

readme.section: 终端配色做了两件具体的事
readme.text:
| token | 暗色 | 对应 ANSI |
|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | `#FFC53D` | 金琥珀（Campbell 的 brightYellow 只有 34% 饱和度，在纯黑上发灰，换成了 76% 的琥珀）|
| `string` | `#16C60C` | brightGreen |
| `string-expression` | `#13A10E` | green |
| `constant` | `#3B78FF` | brightBlue |
| `function` | `#61D6D6` | brightCyan |
| `parameter` | `#E74856` | brightRed |
| `comment` | `#767676` | brightBlack |
| `punctuation` | `#CCCCCC` | white |
| `link` | `#3B78FF` | brightBlue |

readme.section: 终端配色做了两件具体的事
readme.text:
**② 代码面板拉开对比度。** 页面炭灰 `#23272F` + 代码块纯黑 `#000000`，感知亮度差 **ΔL\* 15.6**（原设计只有 5.3）。另有 4px 蓝色左缘竖条 + 1px 内描边（用 `box-shadow` 画，不影响布局）。

> 这里有个教训：相邻深色块的差异**不能用 WCAG 对比度衡量**。上述改动在 WCAG 上只从 1.11:1 变到 1.40:1（26%），而实际感知差异是 **194%** —— 近黑色落在传输曲线的陡峭段，比值量不出来。

**[dsh-pet-indesktop](https://github.com/MerZlin/dsh-pet-indesktop)** —— 把蓝色大肥鱼桌宠移植到 Windows / Linux / macOS，基于 [PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)，并额外实现了其他交互功能。安装方式见它自己的 README。

为什么搭：**同一套鲸鱼娘形象，分工互补** —— 这个主题管界面配色和水印，那只桌宠管桌面上会动的那只。两个一起用，工作环境从里到外都是蓝色大肥鱼（上面主界面截图的右下角就是它）。

**方式一 · 插件市场**：在 DSH 的插件市场里填入仓库地址。

**方式二 · 依赖标识**：把

```text
github:xuyixi992/dsh-fish-theme
```

交给 DSH 的插件安装（`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 传这个标识）。

安装后**必须重启一次 DSH** —— 宿主端注册 22 条图片路由，那是在启动时完成的。
**设置 → 通用 → 定制配色**。四项：定制配色 / 行内代码底色 / 可切换底图 / 可切换底图浓淡。

1. 图片放进 `images/`，命名成 `<id>.webp`
2. `index.js` 的 `IMAGE_IDS` 加一条 `<id>`
3. `client.js` 的 `SWITCHABLES` 加一条 `{ id: '<id>', name: '显示名', kind: '…' }`

`kind` 决定退底方式，**按透明占比选**：

| `kind` | 条件 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | 透明像素 > 10% | 纯合成，透明贴纸用这个 |
| `cutout` | 不透明且四角接近纯白 | `multiply` 抹掉白底 |
| `scene` | 其余（满幅无底色）| 径向遮罩羽化边缘 |

宿主端的 console 从会话里看不到，所以每一步都写进：

```text
%TEMP%\dsh-fish-theme-host.log        （Linux/macOS: $TMPDIR/dsh-fish-theme-host.log）
```

**故意不写在包目录里** —— 从 git 装进来时包在 pnpm store 内，写入不可靠；而且发布后日志不该跟源码混在一起。

`client.js` 里把 `SWITCHABLES` 清空（或只留自绘图），同时删掉 `images/` 下相应的文件 —— 代码部分就能以纯 MIT 发布了。

- 水印是**绝对定位的装饰层**，不参与布局，也不影响你选中文字（`pointer-events: none`）
- 侧栏拖动、窗口缩放会触发重排；**其他布局变化不会**
- 选择记忆存在 **localStorage**，绑定在打开 DSH 时的 origin 上；换端口或换主机名打开时记忆不跟随（重选一次即可）。DSH 客户端服务目录里**没有持久化状态服务**，所以这是唯一可用的存储
- 水印图按**高度**定尺寸并封顶；如果换的图特别宽，宽度可能超出预期

A theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: five colour palettes (light and
dark defined for every token), two independent background watermarks, and
Shiki syntax recolouring based on Windows Terminal's Campbell scheme. Choices
persist in localStorage.

The source code is **MIT**; the artwork under `images/` is third-party fan art
under **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** and carries the attribution listed above. You cannot
relicense the artwork, and it may not be used commercially.
<div align="center">
**Whale-girl palettes · two-layer watermarks · terminal-inspired dark theme** A theme plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Web UI [中文](README.md) · **English** ---

| Main screen | Settings panel |
|---|---|
|  |  |

Left: the **fixed** watermark (standing maid illustration) runs down the left edge,
the **switchable** watermark sits at the lower left of the content column (「吃饱饱」
is selected here), and the little character at the **lower right** is the desktop
pet — see [Companion project](#companion-project).

Right: the four option rows under Settings → General, with the 21-image picker.

> Both screenshots are **light mode** (the *teal* palette). The **terminal palette
> only shows its black code panels and amber keywords in dark mode.**
>
> 🌙 **In dark mode, set the switchable watermark's strength to 浓 (strong).** The
> fixed layer uses `multiply`, a blend designed for a white ground — on a dark
> background "dark × art" stays dark, so the watermark fades to nearly nothing.
> Some images in the switchable layer work the same way, so 浓 is the safer
> setting across the board.

A skin for the DSH Web UI. It does three things:

1. **Repaints the whole colour token set** — five palettes, each defining light and
   dark values for every token
2. **Stacks two background watermarks** — one fixed, one switchable
3. **Recolours code syntax** — nine token classes, using Windows Terminal's palette

Your choices are **remembered**; leaving and re-entering Settings no longer resets them.

| Name | Character |
|---|---|
| 青蓝 · azure | Cool blue, the default |
| 素白 · crisp | No colour cast, the most neutral |
| 靛紫 · indigo | Violet |
| 墨青 · teal | Blue-green |
| **终端 · terminal** | **Modelled on Windows Terminal: a pure-black code panel and amber keywords in dark mode** |

Each layer owns its own pseudo-element (`body::after` / `body::before`), because a
single element's `opacity` applies to **all** of its background layers — separate
elements are the only way to give them separate strengths.

| Layer | Content | Adjustable |
|---|---|---|
| **Fixed** | Standing maid illustration, left edge | ❌ Locked to 淡 (faint); deliberately not user-facing |
| **Switchable** | Any of 21 stickers | ✅ Image + strength (off / faint / medium / strong) |

> 🌙 **In dark mode, set the strength to 浓 (strong)** — see the note under Preview.
> The fixed layer stays at 淡 and is likewise very faint on a dark background; that
> is a known trade-off, made so it can never be nudged out of place.

**Why the blend modes differ.** A white-ground illustration uses
`mix-blend-mode: multiply` to erase the ground and leave only the line work. A
transparent sticker must **not** use multiply — it would crush light colours into
mud — so it composites normally instead. Each image's `kind` is decided by
**measuring its transparent coverage**, never by eye.

**Position is measured at runtime.** The switchable layer's left offset is read
from the page's inline `grid-template-columns`, which carries the sidebar's real
width (the sidebar is draggable, 264–420px). It therefore re-lays-out when you
release a sidebar drag, instead of being pinned to a hardcoded 280px.

`褐色 · brown` (default — sampled from the active palette's `warn` hue, which on the
terminal palette is the very amber the keywords use) · `中性 · neutral` · `冷青 · cyan` ·
`跟随 · follow accent` · `无底色 · none`

readme.section: Two concrete things the terminal palette does
readme.text:
**① Syntax recolouring.** Shiki's colours are **not theme tokens** — they are plain
CSS custom properties (`--shiki-token-*`) declared in `ui-theme/src/styles/shiki.css`.
The theme's 29 tokens contain **no code-colouring entries at all**, so overriding
those custom properties is the only option. It uses the **exact same selectors** as
the shipped sheet (`:root` / `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`) and wins on injection order,
with no `!important`.

readme.section: Two concrete things the terminal palette does
readme.text:
The nine token classes come from Windows Terminal's **Campbell** scheme — the default
PowerShell 7 colours on Windows 11:

readme.section: Two concrete things the terminal palette does
readme.text:
| token | dark value | ANSI name |
|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | `#FFC53D` | amber (Campbell's brightYellow is only 34% saturated and reads as grey on black; swapped for a 76% amber) |
| `string` | `#16C60C` | brightGreen |
| `string-expression` | `#13A10E` | green |
| `constant` | `#3B78FF` | brightBlue |
| `function` | `#61D6D6` | brightCyan |
| `parameter` | `#E74856` | brightRed |
| `comment` | `#767676` | brightBlack |
| `punctuation` | `#CCCCCC` | white |
| `link` | `#3B78FF` | brightBlue |

readme.section: Two concrete things the terminal palette does
readme.text:
**② The code panel earns its contrast.** Page charcoal `#23272F` against a pure-black
code block `#000000` gives a perceptual lightness difference of **ΔL\* 15.6** (the
original design managed 5.3). A 4px blue accent runs down the left edge, plus a 1px
inner border — both drawn with `box-shadow` so the panel's geometry never shifts.

readme.section: Two concrete things the terminal palette does
readme.text:
> A lesson worth recording: **WCAG contrast ratio cannot measure the difference
> between two adjacent dark surfaces.** That change moved WCAG from 1.11:1 to
> 1.40:1 (26%), while the perceived difference was **194%** — near-blacks sit in the
> steep part of the transfer curve, where a ratio cannot see them.

**[dsh-pet-indesktop](https://github.com/MerZlin/dsh-pet-indesktop)** ports the blue
fat-fish desktop pet to Windows / Linux / macOS, based on
[PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet), with extra
interactions. See its own README for installation.

Why they pair: **the same whale-girl character, with complementary jobs.** This theme
dresses the interface; the pet is the one that moves around your desktop. Run both and
your whole working environment is blue fat fish (it is the character at the lower right
of the main screenshot above).

**Option 1 · plugin marketplace** — paste the repository URL into the DSH plugin
marketplace.

**Option 2 · dependency spec** — hand this to the DSH plugin installer
(`plugin_manager`, action `install_bundle`, with the spec as `target`):

```text
github:xuyixi992/dsh-fish-theme
```

**Restart DSH once after installing** — the host half registers 22 image routes, and
that happens at startup.

**Settings → General → 定制配色.** Four rows: palette / inline code background /
switchable watermark / switchable watermark strength.

readme.section: Swapping in your own watermark images
readme.text:
1. Drop the image into `images/`, named `<id>.webp`
2. Add `<id>` to `IMAGE_IDS` in `index.js`
3. Add `{ id: '<id>', name: 'Label', kind: '…' }` to `SWITCHABLES` in `client.js`

`kind` picks how the ground is removed — **choose it from the measured transparent
coverage**:

readme.section: Swapping in your own watermark images
readme.text:
| `kind` | Condition | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | more than 10% transparent pixels | Plain compositing; use for transparent stickers |
| `cutout` | opaque with near-white corners | `multiply` erases the white ground |
| `scene` | anything else (full-bleed, no removable ground) | Radial mask feathers the edges |

The host console is not reachable from a session, so every step is appended to:

```text
%TEMP%\dsh-fish-theme-host.log        (Linux/macOS: $TMPDIR/dsh-fish-theme-host.log)
```

**Deliberately not inside the package directory** — installed from a git URL the
package lives inside pnpm's store, where writing is unreliable; and a published
package should not litter its own sources with logs.

readme.section: If you want to drop the artwork
readme.text:
Empty `SWITCHABLES` in `client.js` (or keep only your own drawings) and delete the
corresponding files from `images/` — the code alone can then be published under plain
MIT.

- The watermarks are **absolutely positioned decoration**: they take no part in layout
  and never block text selection (`pointer-events: none`)
- A sidebar drag or a window resize triggers a re-layout; **other layout changes do not**
- The remembered selection lives in **localStorage**, keyed to the origin DSH was
  opened on. Change the port or hostname and the memory does not follow (just pick
  again). The DSH client service catalog exposes **no persisted-state store**, so this
  is the only storage available to a client-only plugin
- Watermark images are sized by **height** with a cap; an unusually wide image may end
  up wider than you expect
